ranking_basis: Qualitative expected information gain for HOLDOUT-DTI per implementation cost, not numeric improvement estimates or leaderboard projections. Novelty is scoped to executable src/ and scripts/ in this checkout, not all 92 projects or the scientific literature.

common_data_requirement.caveat: A native raster mirror is not the actual template cached feature stack and does not authenticate organizer-origin bytes. Obtainability is documented by the session restoration receipt, not inferred from a URL. No external USGS product is called viable without acquired bytes.

hypotheses.name: Local cross-spectral gravity-magnetic admittance breaks
hypotheses.physical_signature: Within tapered, overlapping windows, estimate gravity-magnetic cross-spectrum, coherence and scale-dependent admittance. Test a spatially persistent change in the relationship across a corridor against within-window phase-scrambled controls. Define numerical windows, frequency bands and regularization only in a future authorized preregistration, before any holdout evaluation.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: A buried displacement or juxtaposition could change the joint density/magnetization relationship despite lacking a surface scarp. This is a hypothesis, not proof that any recovered catalogue segment represents an unmapped fault.
hypotheses.novelty: Carries forward the unrun H86F-CSPA cross-spectral proposal. H86F-GZZD evaluates local gravity curvature dipoles; H86F-PCC evaluates signed local gradient alignment. Neither implements windowed cross-spectral admittance. It is not claimed as a newly invented geological theory.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Unfaulted lithologic juxtaposition, source-depth changes, remanent volcanic magnetization, and mismatched survey resolution.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: First qualitative priority: potentially information beyond amplitude edges; substantial risk that both fields trace the same non-fault contacts.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium; windowed FFTs and resolution-matched controls, CPU feasible in principle.
hypotheses.falsifier: No positive paired spatial-block HOLDOUT-DTI delta against frozen same-split controls, or no gain over phase-scrambled controls.

hypotheses.name: Magnetic monogenic phase-congruency lineaments
hypotheses.physical_signature: Use log-Gabor even and Riesz odd responses to identify cross-scale local phase alignment; require consistent axial orientation and test gravity corroboration. Compare at fixed emission budget with amplitude-only magnetic-edge controls.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: A weak magnetic marker buried beneath cover might retain phase alignment even when amplitude ranking suppresses it. The relevant observation is hypothesized marker continuity, not catalogue proximity.
hypotheses.novelty: No monogenic, Riesz, log-Gabor or phase-congruency implementation was found in src/ or scripts/ during this review. Existing MMT shifts marker responses; existing ridge/persistence fields use amplitudes and derivatives rather than normalized phase agreement.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Lava-flow boundaries, dikes, interpolation ringing and GeoDAWN survey seams.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Second qualitative priority; contrast invariance might rescue weak structures, but no fault-specific causal evidence yet.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium; multi-scale FFT filtering and orientation controls.
hypotheses.falsifier: Phase normalization does not beat amplitude-only ranking at a matched budget on the identical buffered holdout.

hypotheses.name: Persistent potential-field saddle connections
hypotheses.physical_signature: Construct scale-persistent Morse-style saddle-to-extremum connections and test aligned connectors across independently filtered potential fields, with graph-topology randomization controls. Do not interpret gravity-derived basement depth as independent corroborating evidence.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: A buried connecting structure between anomaly bodies might be missed by peak-only ridge detection and surface scarp mapping. A connector alone does not establish fault displacement.
hypotheses.novelty: Current CTHB uses local Hessian ridges, truncations, cross-gradients and visible-fault relay mechanics, not persistence-ranked potential-field saddle-connection graphs.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Intrusive contacts, erosional basement relief and saddle points created by superposed unfaulted sources.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Third qualitative priority; structurally different coverage, but weak uniqueness of geological interpretation.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium-high; robust topology extraction and persistence controls.
hypotheses.falsifier: Connector topology fails to beat spatially randomized connectors or simple ridges on paired physical-block HOLDOUT-DTI.

hypotheses.name: Conductivity-neck topology conditioned on dilatation
hypotheses.physical_signature: Test narrow persistent necks joining conductive regions, conditioned on positive dilatation and compared with a broad-conductivity and strain-only control. No MT depth migration can be inferred from this single conductivity band.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: A narrow buried fluid pathway could connect broader conductive alteration or sediment regions without exposing a scarp. Conductivity and strain alone cannot identify a geothermal vent.
hypotheses.novelty: CTHB clay-cap margin gradients and FVMB conductive halos do not explicitly extract persistent neck topology between conductive components. This is not a new depth-resolved MT data product.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Connected saline playa sediments, clay-rich paleochannels and interpolation bottlenecks.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Fourth qualitative priority; weakest specificity because conductivity is not unique to hydrothermal fluids.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium; multi-threshold topology and width/strain controls.
hypotheses.falsifier: No paired HOLDOUT-DTI gain over broad-conductivity/strain-only controls or instability to threshold changes.

required_before_any_experiment: An explicit single assigned method lane
Actual shared cached feature stack restored and content/implementation/visible-mask identities bound
A protocol disposition that does not silently waive the literal overlap stop
A complete valid same-grid registry, with explicit handling of the two incompatible records
Frozen matched buffered hide-and-recover controls; all catalogue features derived only from visible faults
Feature-alone leakage canaries before trusting any candidate; stop above 0.90 discriminative AUC
At most three experiments or two hours; no weekly-slot action
